en: Our best Miltank's fallen sick. She won't give a drop of milk, and she's barely eaten in days.
Lots of Oran Berries might perk her up. If you've any to spare, she's in the barn next door.
Fresh Moomoo Milk! Want some? It'll restore 100 HP to a Pokémon.
Here you go! Drink it up while it's fresh.
Here you go! A dozen bottles, fresh from our Miltank.
Sorry, you haven't got the money for that.
Come back if you get thirsty!
Our Miltank's sick, poor thing. We've tried everything we can think of.
You made our Miltank well again! I can't thank you enough. Please, take this.
TM83 is Natural Gift. Its power and type change with the Berry the Pokémon holds. Fitting, isn't it?
